verdict: MRVL S&P 500 inclusion (Jun 22) + Jensen 'next trillion' call dominate; AVGO Q3 AI guide $16B (+143% YoY); HIVE lands $220M sovereign GPU deal; solar Sec 232 ruling imminent; memory memflation moderating but still strongly up.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**S1 — DRAM/HBM pricing:** No fresh June TrendForce print. Standing data: Q2 2026 conventional DRAM +58-63% QoQ (moderating from Q1's +90-95%). HBM3e premium over DDR5 narrowing (was 4-5x; projected ~1-2x by year-end). Buyers now negotiating 2027 HBM4 supply agreements.

**S2 — HBM4/capacity ramp:** SK Hynix slipped HBM4 ramp from Q2 → Q3 (HBM3E still in high demand). Samsung targeting 250K wafers/mo (+47%). NVIDIA pushing for 16-layer HBM4 by H2. Baseline "correction after 2026" risk intact — all three suppliers expanding simultaneously.

**S3 — Hyperscaler capex:** No guide-down. AVGO Q3 guide ($29.4B revenue, AI semiconductor $16B, +143% YoY) is the freshest demand proxy. Combined GOOGL+MSFT+META+AMZN 2026 capex ~$725B confirmed and unchanged.

**S4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** AMD MI400/Helios confirmed on track H2 2026. Meta MTIA gens 300-500 mapped through 2027. No new AMD-specific print this week.

**S5 — Optical/Photonics:** COHR CEO on record: InP shortage likely persists through 2027. Rothschild initiated ALAB + CRDO (among 6 AI connectivity names) this week. No new transceiver lead-time data.

**S6 — Solar:** Section 232 polysilicon tariff decision still pending (President's ~90-day window closes late June/early July). Solar stocks +40% YTD on anticipation. No final ruling yet — binary event watch.

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| **MRVL** | Surging | S&P 500 inclusion Jun 22 + Jensen Huang names it "next trillion-dollar company" + Keybanc PT $385 (Jun 18) + B. Riley PT $345 (Jun 12) + guidance reaffirmed above Street |
| **AVGO** | +3% Jun 18 | Debt buyback raised $2.5B→$3B (initial settlement Jun 18); Q3 AI semi revenue guided $16B (+143% YoY); Q3 total revenue $29.4B (+84% YoY) |
| **HIVE** | Catalyst | BUZZ HPC closed $220M sovereign AI GPU deal (Bell AI Fabric / Cohere); 2,304 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 GPUs; contracted ARR jumps $35M→$105M+; deployment late 2026 |
| **ALAB** | +11.3% | Rothschild initiation; Q1 revenue +93% YoY; CRDO also at all-time high on AI connectivity demand |
| **MU** | Watch Jun 24 | Earnings: Q3 guided record $33.5B revenue, ~81% gross margin — beat-and-raise setup |
| **FSLR** | +40% YTD | Section 232 ruling imminent; UBS raised PT $290→$330 on Jun 11 (+9% that day) |

## Context vs Baseline

Memflation is moderating (Q2 +63% vs Q1 +95%) but still strongly inflationary — no correction phase yet. AVGO's $16B Q3 AI semiconductor guide is the clearest hyperscaler-demand confirmation this week, reinforcing the MRVL/ALAB/CRDO custom-ASIC/networking thesis. HIVE's $220M sovereign GPU deal is first major BUZZ HPC contract win — bulls flag ARR tripling; bears note dilution risk and late-2026/early-2027 deployment lag.

## Most Important Development

**MRVL S&P 500 inclusion (effective June 22) + Jensen Huang publicly naming it the "next trillion-dollar company."** Compulsory index-rebalancing flows arriving precisely when analyst PTs are catching up dramatically (consensus ~$220 → Keybanc high $385). This is the week's highest-conviction watchlist event — tie the move to both the index mechanic and the NVIDIA/hyperscaler custom-silicon demand story.
